verdict.rationale: Motion's meeting assistant docs say video conferencing links are added automatically to every meeting, and its integrations page documents scheduling Zoom calls from Motion, which covers the core of the story. Meet and Teams appear only in the context of turning meetings into tasks, not link generation. missing for 10: documented Google Meet/Teams/native video link generation for bookings, per-booking-type provider configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, every booking gets a video conference link automatically (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, or native video)

citations.quote: Video conferencing links are automatically added to every meeting, eliminating the pre-meeting scramble for access codes.
Schedule and join Zoom calls directly from Motion.
